name: switchboard
description: Routes each prompt to the cheapest Claude model and effort level that fits it (Haiku for lookups, Sonnet for routine edits, Opus for architecture, security and hard bugs), from a UserPromptSubmit hook that stays quiet when the current model already fits. When it does not fit, the prompt runs in a subagent with the chosen model and effort; the session's own setting is unchanged. Also flags when a session grows past each 100k tokens, lists its artifacts, and writes a carry-over brief so a new session can pick them up.
